results.title: Finding relief at Rebound Orthopedics and Neurosurgery
results.description: FOX 12’s Wayne Garcia visits Rebound Orthopedics and Neurosurgery to explore options for treating neck and back pain. Physiatrists Deven Karvelas, M.D., and David Impastato, M.D., explain how many conditions can be effectively managed with non-surgical treatments. When surgery is needed, neurosurgeons Wael Musleh, M.D., Ph.D., and Hoang Le, M.D., share how advances in technology are improving precision, care, and recovery.
